positive: independent candidate for every ABC job
reload: all ABC, first seed, families 0,1,5,6; 12 jobs
threshold_rule: scale = calibration reference feature population std floored 1e-6; distance = RMS standardized delta; tolerance=max(1e-5,10*max calibration positive including reload); proceed with 54 if all calibration negatives exceed tolerance; otherwise stop for one alternate decision before heldout
collision: two actual generations with equal effective tokens; exclude from fitting
